annotations.title: Ad copy generator with platform limits

description: Ad copy generator with platform limits — Generate ad copy for Google Ads (responsive search: 10 headlines of 30 chars + 4 descriptions of 90 chars), Meta/Facebook/Instagram (primary text 125, headline 40, description 30), LinkedIn (intro 150, headline 70) or X (post 280, card headline 70). Character limits are enforced offline (over-limit text trimmed at a word boundary and marked), duplicates removed, and policy-style flags raised (exclamation in Google headlines, ALL-CAPS, repeated punctuation). Params: product (required brief), platform=google|meta|linkedin|x (default google), audience, tone, keywords, cta, count=1-5 variants (non-Google). Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

product.description: What you advertise, key benefit and offer, e.g. Payroll software for small teams, 30-day free trial
